title: QuickNames
description: The mod extracts the most meaningful part of the address — skipping generic prefixes like play, mc, hub and domain suffixes like .net, .com. If you type your own custom server name, the mod leaves it completely untouched
body:
Tired of your server list being full of "Minecraft Server"?

UtilsMod is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that automatically generates a clean server name from the IP address when you leave the name as default.

How it works:

You open Multiplayer → Add Server
Leave the Server Name as "Minecraft Server" (the default) — don't touch it
Type your server address (e.g. play.totemmc.net) and hit Done
The mod automatically names the server "totemmc" for you!
Smart name extraction:

hypixel.net → hypixel
play.totemmc.net → totemmc
mc.hypixel.net → hypixel
totemmc.net:25565 → totemmc (ports are stripped)
The mod extracts the most meaningful part of the address — skipping generic prefixes like play, mc, hub and domain suffixes like .net, .com. If you type your own custom server name, the mod leaves it completely untouched.

100% client-side — no server installation needed. Just drop it in your mods folder and go.
